messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGING: High p99/tail latency observed on inference path affecting streaming responses. Alerts: p99 > 10s for inference_gateway and streaming proxy. Auto thresholds hit for last 5m. Paging sre-oncall.

sre-oncall: looking. seeing elevated p95/p99 across eu-west1 and us-central. Tail spikes correlate with config fetch errors (503) from configstore and auth 429s from tokenstore.

emily.prod: customer-impact: a handful of premium customers reported streaming stalls and aborted streams. CS flagged 3 active support tickets. Not global but hits routing layer for long sessions.

neil.infra: checking logs — lots of `featureflags` fetches returning 503s and `GET /v1/configs` latency > 2s. Also token service is returning 429s, rate-limited.

db-team-lead: db metrics look ok on CPU/RDS side. But configstore frontends show connection pool exhaustion. retry storms from clients maybe exacerbating.

sre-oncall: quick triage hypothesis: feature flag/remote config failures causing requests to block on control-plane calls during streaming init, then retries cause cascading queuing -> tail latency.

alice.product: any recent feature flag rollout? We pushed a new gate in the last hour to enable a new sampling path.

emily.prod: yes, rolled `ff/new-stream-cache` ~45m ago. Could be a spike in reads if the rollout caused a path that hits featurestore frequently.

neil.infra: can we toggle the flag to rollback? What's the runbook for fast rollback? @deploy-bot any automated shortcut?

deploy-bot: automated rollback available for `ff/new-stream-cache` via internal console. Recommend canary-step revert -> full rollout revert. I can run step 1 on approval.

sre-oncall: before rollback, mitigation attempt: enable control-plane local cache fallback (ttl extension) to stop sync calls. Also increase tokenstore client retry backoff and 429 backoff jitter.

db-team-lead: will enable local cache TTL bump and open a short-lived read-only cache for feature flags. Applying in 30s.

neil.infra: also pushing a config to limit concurrent config client connections at gateway to 50 per instance to avoid pool exhaustion. Applying now.

sre-oncall: deploying change to gateway: `set MAX_CONFIG_CONNS=50; set TOKEN_RETRY_BASE=200` -> patch pushed to canary.

deploy-bot: canary deploy started to 3 instances in us-central.

sre-oncall: monitoring traces. p99 dropping slightly but still above target. Streaming stalls still intermittently reported.

emily.prod: CS: 2 customers escalated to priority. They're seeing streams hang during initial tokens then reconnect loop.

alice.product: if rollback helps we'll plan to revert the flag. Rollback approved if we don't see improvement in 5m.

neil.infra: can we also route traffic away from eu-west1 to us-central temporarily? Edge routing policy can shift 20% traffic for 10m.

sre-oncall: do it. Start traffic shift now, 20% -> us-central. Observability: traces show eu-west1 p99 worse than us-central, so should help.

deploy-bot: traffic routing update done: 20% shifted. Logs: `route-change-id: rc-1745009876-1`.

sre-oncall: p99 down from ~12s to ~7s after TTL bump + routing shift. Still above SLO but improving. Streaming stalls reduced.

db-team-lead: feature flag local cache enabled. configstore 5xxs dropping, tokenstore 429s dropping too after backoff change.

emily.prod: CS: customers still impacted but severity reduced. They've paused active escalations while we continue mitigation. Will keep them updated.

sre-oncall: next steps: 1) if p99 < 5s in 10m, hold and monitor; 2) if not, perform full rollback of `ff/new-stream-cache`; 3) postmortem to include why rollout caused sync-on-path and missing fallback.

alice.product: concur. I'm ready to trigger rollback after 10m if needed.

neil.infra: monitor open file descriptors and connection pool metrics; will revert MAX_CONFIG_CONNS if any adverse effect.

deploy-bot: canary health OK for gateway patch. No errors in logs from the canary instances.

sre-oncall: 6m check: p99 ~4.8s, p95 ~800ms. Streaming stalls down to baseline-ish. Let's keep monitoring for 20m then start incident unwind.

cs-lead: I'll message affected accounts with a short status update: 'We're mitigating an issue affecting streaming; latency improved and we're monitoring; we'll follow up with root cause.'

db-team-lead: recording mitigation steps in incident log. Will keep feature flag rollback as fallback.

sre-oncall: handing off to oncall-monitor for post-incident watch. If we see a regression escalate back to oncall. Good job team.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: status=mitigated_by_controls, severity=high->medium, action=monitoring, incident_id=inc-1745009876.

sre-oncall: adding notes for postmortem: timing of feature flag rollout, missing cache fallback, control-plane auth 429s, retry storms, mitigations (cache TTL bump, conn limit, routing shift). Assign owners: alice.product (rollout), neal.infra (controls), db-team-lead (configstore), emily.prod (customer comms).

alice.product: will open postmortem doc and link in channel within 2 hours.

sre-oncall: done for now. Closing live handoff — oncall-monitor will watch until 1745014076 and escalate if needed. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
